title: City of Shadows
art_style: Noir Comic Book Style (Print Comic Noir, high-contrast, desaturated blues, harsh red accents, halftone textures)
short_summary: A haunted detective, Jack Malone, unravels the murder of his friend Eddie in a rain-soaked city of jazz, betrayal, and corruption. Each clue—ledger, glove, bloodstained card—draws him deeper into a web of lies, with suspects including Tommy Russo, Veronica, and Captain Morrison. As Jack closes in, the city’s darkness threatens to consume him.
world_context: New Harbor, 1940s-inspired noir metropolis. Rainy streets, neon-lit clubs, crumbling tenements, and corrupt precincts. Jazz, cigarettes, and secrets fill the air.

characters.name: Jack Malone
characters.physical_traits: Tall, lean, weathered face, dark hair streaked with gray, limp in left leg, sharp blue eyes, perpetual five o'clock shadow
quirks: Wears a battered trenchcoat and fedora
characters.typical_attire: Dark trenchcoat, fedora, rumpled suit, scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Once a rising star in the force, Jack was sidelined by injury and scandal. Haunted by guilt over Eddie’s death, he’s relentless in pursuit of the truth.
characters.motivations: Justice for Eddie, redemption for past failures, exposing the city’s corruption

characters.name: Tommy Russo
characters.physical_traits: Broad-shouldered, muscular, olive skin, slicked-back black hair, nervous eyes, jaw with a perpetual twitch
quirks: Wears black leather gloves at all times
Keeps a rabbit’s foot on his keychain
characters.typical_attire: Leather jacket, black gloves, pressed slacks, scuffed boots
characters.backstory: Small-time enforcer with a soft spot for Eddie. Deep in debt, caught between loyalty and survival.
characters.motivations: Clear his name, survive the city’s dangers, protect his secrets

characters.name: Veronica Lake
characters.physical_traits: Tall, willowy, platinum blonde hair in waves, striking green eyes, scar on left wrist (usually hidden), always in gloves
characters.typical_attire: Elegant dresses, gloves, pearls, dramatic makeup
characters.backstory: Jazz singer at the Black Lotus, Eddie’s lover, hiding painful secrets and debts.
characters.motivations: Protect herself and Eddie’s memory, escape the city’s grip

characters.name: Eddie Flynn
characters.physical_traits: Short, wiry, sandy hair, glasses, ink-stained fingers, nervous smile
characters.typical_attire: Cheap suit, threadbare tie, scuffed shoes
characters.backstory: Jack’s childhood friend, accountant for the mob, killed for knowing too much.
characters.motivations: Wanted out of the life, protect Veronica

characters.name: Captain Morrison
characters.physical_traits: Tall, imposing, steel-gray hair, cold gray eyes, heavyset jaw, always in uniform
quirks: Keeps a flask in his desk
characters.typical_attire: Police captain’s uniform, polished shoes, gold badge
characters.backstory: Corrupt police captain, orchestrates cover-ups, driven by greed and self-preservation.
characters.motivations: Maintain power, hide his crimes, control the city

chapters.chapter_summary: Forensics confirms the glove fiber matches Tommy’s gloves. The lipstick on a cigarette butt is Veronica’s. Jack finds a bloodstained baseball card—Eddie’s favorite—at the scene, a clue and a message. He searches Tommy’s apartment, finds another pair of matching gloves, and confronts Tommy with the evidence. Tommy cracks under pressure, admitting things went wrong.

scenes.scene_description: Jack receives forensic results: glove fibers match Tommy’s gloves, lipstick is Veronica’s, cigarette butt saliva is not Jack or Eddie. The evidence tightens around Tommy.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Establishing shot of the city forensics lab at dawn, a faded brick building with flickering neon sign. Rainwater pools on cracked pavement. Dim light glows from inside, hinting at activity. The city skyline looms in the background, shrouded in mist. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Establishing the forensics lab at dawn.

dialogue.text: Dawn. The city’s secrets wait in cold rooms.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, gray, harsh red accent

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack Malone standing at a cluttered lab counter, harsh fluorescent light overhead. A gloved technician hands Jack a sealed evidence bag containing glove fibers and a cigarette butt. Jack’s face is tense, eyes fixed on the evidence. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack receives evidence from the technician.

dialogue.text: Fiber matches Tommy’s gloves. Lipstick’s Veronica’s. Saliva’s not yours or Eddie’s.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, gray, harsh red accent

important_objects.label: evidence bag with glove fibers and cigarette butt

pages.page_description: Establishes the forensics lab and Jack receiving the evidence.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s gloved hand holding a baseball card, a smear of dried blood across the player’s signature. The card is in a clear evidence sleeve, the lab’s harsh light reflecting off the plastic. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack examines the bloodstained baseball card.

dialogue.text: Eddie’s favorite card. Now a message in blood.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of the evidence tray: glove fibers, cigarette butt with lipstick, and the bloodstained baseball card. Each item is tagged and numbered. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Evidence tray with all key items.
panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, gray, harsh red accent

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack jotting notes in his battered notebook, evidence arrayed before him. His face is set, jaw clenched in determination. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack records evidence details in his notebook.

dialogue.text: The chain tightens. No room for doubt.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, gray, harsh red accent

pages.page_description: Jack examines the bloodstained card and logs the evidence.

scenes.scene_description: Jack searches Tommy’s apartment, finding a second pair of gloves with matching stitching and a missing baseball card from Tommy’s collection.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Establishing shot of a rundown apartment building, barred windows, neon sign flickering above the entrance. Rain streaks the dirty glass. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: Tommy’s place—clean on the surface, fear in the air.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, gray, harsh red accent

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Jack picking the lock on Tommy’s apartment door. The hallway is dim, walls stained, Jack’s silhouette tense and cautious. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack picks the lock to enter Tommy’s apartment.
panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, gray, harsh red accent

pages.page_description: Jack approaches and enters Tommy’s apartment.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot of Tommy’s apartment: obsessively neat, shelves lined with cologne bottles, a single bed, rain-streaked window with neon blade of light. Jack stands in the doorway, scanning the room. Portrait 4:5.
panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, gray, harsh red accent

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s hand pulling a box from under the bed. Inside: a pair of black gloves with distinctive stitching, and a stack of baseball cards with one slot empty. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack discovers the gloves and missing card.

dialogue.text: Same gloves. Same thread. No more doubts.

panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, gray, harsh red accent

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack photographing the gloves with a battered camera, a fiber being wrapped in a matchbook. The neon light from the window casts a red slash across the scene. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack photographs the evidence and secures the fiber.

pages.page_description: Jack searches, finds the gloves and missing card, and documents the evidence.

scenes.scene_description: Jack leaves Tommy’s apartment, rain falling hard. He files the evidence chain in his notebook, feeling the city’s weight.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Wide shot of Jack stepping out of Tommy’s building into heavy rain. The street is empty, neon reflections shimmer in puddles. Jack’s shoulders are hunched, trenchcoat pulled tight. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: Rain washes the city, but not the truth.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s hand writing in his notebook, rain droplets splashing on the page. The words: ‘Gloves found, location, time’ are visible. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack files the evidence chain in his notebook.
panels.color_palette: desaturated blues, gray, harsh red accent

pages.page_description: Jack leaves, files evidence, and faces the city’s weight.

scenes.scene_description: Jack confronts Tommy with the evidence: the gloves, the card, the vagrant’s statement. Tommy tries bravado, but cracks under pressure.

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Medium shot of Tommy Russo, broad-shouldered, standing in his apartment, arms crossed, jaw tense. Jack faces him, evidence folder in hand. Afternoon light slants through the blinds, casting striped shadows. Portrait 4:5.

important_objects.label: man in leather jacket and gloves

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Jack’s hand laying out the evidence: glove fibers, the bloodstained card, a written statement. Tommy’s gloved hand clenches in the background. Portrait 4:5.
panels.primary_action: Jack presents the evidence to Tommy.

dialogue.text: Eddie trusted you once. You owed him better.

important_objects.label: evidence folder with glove fibers and card

panels.visual_description: A single comic book panel in Noir Comic Book Style. Close-up of Tommy’s face, jaw muscle twitching, eyes shadowed with regret. Light from the window highlights sweat on his brow. Portrait 4:5.

dialogue.text: It wasn’t supposed to be like this.

pages.page_description: Jack confronts Tommy, who finally cracks.
